system.description:
Deal [(SR+3)D + (Attack Power)] physical damage to the target.

(Hate Top): You gain a +5 bonus to your next damage roll against secondary targets within a range of [Target: Wide 2 (P) / Range: Close] centered on yourself. Treat this effect as a Combat Status that is removed after being applied once.

A special skill that uses a heavy weapon such as a mallet or ax to perform a powerful rush. A blow like a battering ram that breaks through the castle gate gives momentum to allies.
